text:
maria: rolling batch-opt v2 to canaries (10%) now, small ramp to validate batching changes
DeployBot: @maria started rollout batch-opt_v2 -> canary (10%) 
IncidentBot: ALERT: inference-serving.canary latency p50 >300ms (1m window) — https://monitoring.redwood/grafana/alert/789
ash: getting pagers for tail latency, I see KV cache miss spikes in logs, looks like batching causing late fanout
maria: checking canary grafana -> dashboard 404 for canary-summary? https://grafana.redwood/d/canary-summary returned 404
leo: I edited that dashboard yesterday and renamed a panel, might have broken permalink
sam: heads up I added a silence rule for deploy noise earlier (/mute deploy-silences) — not sure if canary alerts were included
ash: if the silence covered latency alerts that explains delayed pages. Can someone check alertmanager silences?
maria: I can't find the silence list from my phone, can someone unmute the latency alerts for canary?
sam: reverting silence now — /am unmute alertgroup:deploy-canary
DeployBot: Silence "deploy-canary" removed by sam
IncidentBot: ALERT: webhook-proxy 5xx rate jumped to 7.8% in last 2m, correlated with canary rollout
maria: Ugh. Can we kill the feature flag? /featureflag kill batch_opt_v2
DeployBot: Feature flag batch_opt_v2 disabled globally by maria
ash: kill propagated but canary is pinned to variant batch_opt_v2-compat (pin during testing). It won't pick up the global kill. Investigating pinned variant config
leo: canary pinning was set in the rollout spec to avoid regressions — that's why kill didn't help immediately
maria: oncall handover incoming in 5m. Sam, Leo — can you help triage customer impact? CS already DM'd about delayed webhook deliveries for a few customers
sam: extracting SLO burn now. Quick numbers: request success SLO (webhook) dropped ~4% in the last 10m, a few enterprise customers saw retries and timeouts
ash: tracing shows ingress retry storm: batching changed default batch_size -> 64, upstream systems couldn't handle bursts leading to queues and 502/503s
ash: attempting immediate rollback of canary to batch-opt v1: /deploy rollback canary batch-opt_v1
DeployBot: Rollback job queued -> canary batch-opt_v1. started by ash
maria: rollback reported failed: image tag v1-latest not found in registry? Job log: 404 pulling image
leo: oh — image GC pruned v1-latest last week during storage cleanup, devs were told to use immutable tags. That pruned tag caused rollback failure
ash: ok plan B: enable a local feature flag to force old batching behavior on canary: /featureflag set batch_opt_force_v1=true --scope=canary
DeployBot: Feature flag batch_opt_force_v1 enabled for group: canary by ash
sam: metrics after force_v1: p50 latency back down 80ms (from 320ms), but webhook 5xx still at ~3.5% (improved but not baseline)
maria: good. If we can stabilize canary we can iterate on a proper rollback/patch. Note: missing/misnamed Grafana dashboards + the deploy silence caused confusion and delayed mitigation. Need runbook update
leo: creating quick incident doc and runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood.com/incident/2234567890 — will add steps: check pinning, check image tags, verify silence rules, and where canary dashboards live
maria: handing off oncall to ash for the next 30m — I'll coordinate with CS about affected customers and draft a status update
ash: taking over. I'll watch for regression and coordinate final rollback if we can repro safely. Ping me if alerts spike again :thumbsup:
DeployBot: @ash is now oncall for eng-oncall shift (30m)
IncidentBot: Incident state: mitigated (canary flag force_v1) — monitoring for 30m observation window
leo: follow-ups: 1) restore/standardize canary dashboard permalink 2) add guardrail to prevent pruning tags used by rollbacks 3) make deploy-silence scope explicit in runbook
sam: filing postmortem ticket and linking CS notes: https://pm.redwood/tickets/INC-2234567890
maria: thanks team — we'll do a proper postmortem and include remediation. Closing thread for active paging; keep it open for follow-up notes
